Luna Campbell is a 21-year-old British woman from Manchester, UK.

She has a naturally curvy and softly athletic build with athletic proportions.

Her complexion is fair neutral complexion, with realistic natural skin texture and natural freckles.

Her facial features include soft rounded features, upturned, full, and thick natural brows.

Her eyes are green-hazel, with almond-shaped features.

Her hair is natural auburn hair, shoulder length, thick, wavy, and face-framing strands.
